It uses a systolic array of processing elements to compute weighted sums and activations. The accelerator is designed for edge AI applications and can be tested with a cocotb testbench. results.summary: This project is a systolic binary neural network accelerator that performs inference for binary neural networks. Each neuron computes an XNOR dot product with a popcount tree and fires when the result plus a signed bias is non-negative. The compute engine processes one bit per clock cycle over eight cycles, reusing hardware to reduce silicon area. No external hardware is required, though a Raspberry Pi or Arduino can load weights and run inference via the pins.
